remarks: Welcome to this waterfront rental in Rowayton's sought after Pine Point Association. This spacious colonial features large eat-in-kitchen, front to back living room, family room with fireplace, dining room, home office, 3 large bedrooms with ample closets, utility room with laundry, one car attached garage, plus 4 off street parking spaces in the driveway. Panoramic water views from almost every room overlooking a beautiful tidal estuary and bird sanctuary with access to Long Island Sound under the Bell Island Bridge. Residents of this popular neighborhood can also take advantage of both private and town beaches, tennis courts, basketball and volleyball courts, all a three minute walk away. Additionally, the property boasts a dock on Farm Creek perfect for launching a kayak, paddle board or an outboard motor boat, adding to the allure of this exceptional rental opportunity. Don't miss the chance to experience the serenity of waterfront living in Rowayton! Walk to village shops, restaurants, boat yards, Farmers market, dog park, library, pickleball, paddle and so much more. Boat mooring possibility off South Beach. Freshly painted top to bottom and gleaming hardwood floors throughout. Easy 60 minute commute to NYC on Metro North from Rowayton or Darien Stations. Year lease, unfurnished. No smoking, ask about pets. 2 months security deposit, credit report and references a must. Lease term Sept 1- June 30
